description: Case do NHÓM tự viết thêm để cover thêm trường hợp. Mỗi case cần: id, phase='B', query HOẶC turns, failure_type (thuộc allowed_failure_types), và expect (tool_calls[...] hoặc no_tool=true). Nên kèm metadata.what_it_tests.

cases.query: Compare news coverage and public discussion on X about robotics from the past month. Return up to 4 news results and 4 posts. Do not scrape or enrich article pages.

metadata.what_it_tests: Routes a cross-platform news-and-X comparison to topic_radar, preserves the one-month window and per-source limit, and disables optional article extraction.

cases.query: Find evidence from 4 different websites for this claim: 'Urban tree cover can lower neighborhood surface temperatures during heat waves.' Return the most relevant passages, but use search snippets only and do not extract full pages.

args.claim: Urban tree cover can lower neighborhood surface temperatures during heat waves.

metadata.what_it_tests: Tests claim extraction, requested number of distinct-domain sources, and disabling deep page extraction.

cases.query: Remove duplicate sources from this list before I prepare the report. Use only local URL and title comparison; do not fetch page contents or call extraction APIs. Results: (1) title 'Climate report 2026', URL https://example.com/climate-report?utm_source=mail; (2) title 'Climate report 2026', URL https://www.example.com/climate-report; (3) title 'Battery recycling policy', URL https://example.org/battery-policy.

metadata.what_it_tests: Routes an already-collected source list to source_deduplicator and respects the user's explicit no-extraction/no-credit boundary. The evaluator checks verify_content but cannot compare the items array of objects.

cases.query: Turn these already-collected notes into a concise research brief titled 'AI Governance Brief'. Do not search for more information. Sources: (1) 'EU adopts new AI Act rules', https://example.com/ai-act, summary: 'The report describes obligations under the AI Act.' (2) 'New AI rules for providers', https://example.org/ai-rules, summary: 'The article explains compliance duties for providers.' (3) 'Research labs update safety practices', https://example.net/ai-safety, summary: 'The article describes updated safety processes.'

metadata.what_it_tests: Uses the local formatter on information already supplied by the user, choosing the brief template and preserving the requested headline instead of searching again.

cases.query: Read the latest 4 articles from the RSS feed at https://openai.com/news/rss.xml, filtering only items mentioning 'safety'. Read the RSS XML feed directly instead of running a general web search or HTML page scrape.

metadata.what_it_tests: Routes a direct RSS feed URL request to rss_feed_reader instead of fetch or lookup, preserving url, max_items, and optional keyword filter.
